{{quotation|game|Unlocks the [[Vault box|Anniversary Storage]] at [[Xunlai Chest]]s. Double-click to redeem.}}

==Acquisition==
* One per [[account]] can be acquired from [[Palora, Sworn to Earth]] by showing a [[Proof of Legend]] to her during the [[Anniversary Celebration]]. Accounts that have already obtained the Anniversary Storage pane will receive a [[Blessing of War]] instead.

==Trivia==
* Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
* Uses the same [[inventory]] icon as a [[Scroll of Rampager's Insight]].
* A [[Proof of Steel]] does not work in place of Proof of Legend.
